frequency_basis.deduplication: one count per product_id and normalized material label, across parts and material groups
frequency_basis.population: 134983 source-market product observations; not unique models
frequency_basis.unknown_scope_suffix: 〔范围待核实〕 stripped from labels; 2795 part tokens require scope review
selection_notes: Disclosure frequency is not a measured material mass or volume fraction.
Source and market coverage is uneven; the sample is not the whole furniture market.
Furniture type counts are observation-level; special types 待复核/配件及寝具/家具套装/其他非家具 are retained for traceability.
The supplied property table contains surrogate properties. Unresolved surrogate densities are withheld from numeric constraints.

candidate_smoothing.normalization: within broad bulk candidate class, before requested limit
